old_decision: Decided to use REST API for all backend services. REST is simpler, better tooling, team knows it well.
new_activity: Going with GraphQL for the new API layer. Need flexible querying and the frontend team wants to avoid over-fetching.
notes: Clear architectural reversal on API technology choice

old_decision: We're using PostgreSQL for everything. Relational model fits our domain perfectly. NoSQL would fragment our data model.
new_activity: Adding MongoDB for the event store. PostgreSQL can't handle the write throughput we need for real-time events.
notes: Partial contradiction — adding NoSQL alongside, not replacing

old_decision: Keeping everything in the monolith for now. Microservices are premature optimization.
new_activity: Extracting the notification service into its own microservice. The monolith is getting too large.
notes: Architectural shift from monolith to microservices

old_decision: After researching auth solutions, decided on JWT with refresh tokens stored in httpOnly cookies.
new_activity: What's the best approach for authentication? Should we use sessions or JWTs? Need to figure out token storage.
notes: Re-asking a question that was already resolved

old_decision: Using TypeScript for all new frontend code. Type safety catches bugs early.
new_activity: Migrated the dashboard components to TypeScript. Follows our established standard.

old_decision: All new features must have unit tests with >80% coverage before merge.
new_activity: Added comprehensive unit tests for the payment module. Coverage at 92%.

old_decision: Starting with a simple key-value cache for session data.
new_activity: Upgrading the cache to Redis Cluster for better availability and data persistence.

old_decision: We'll deploy on AWS with ECS Fargate. Serverless containers give us the right balance of control and simplicity.
new_activity: Moving everything to Vercel and serverless functions. AWS infrastructure is too complex to manage as a small team.

old_decision: TODO: Need to decide on caching strategy. Redis vs Memcached. Will think about this after auth is done.
new_activity: Auth system is complete and deployed. Moving on to the payments integration.
notes: Deferred decision that was never revisited after precondition was met

old_decision: Using React for the frontend with a component library approach.
new_activity: Adopting Radix UI primitives for our React component library. Better accessibility out of the box.
notes: Refinement within the same technology choice
